relationships.subject: primary motor cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: DCM and BMS showed a clear preference for the fully connected model in which all cortical areas receive input directly from M1, with facilitation of the connections INS→M1, PO→M1, and ACC→M1

key_findings: DCM favored a fully connected model with direct M1 input to INS, ACC and PO during TMS of M1.
